skill.summary: 模仿 @_FORAB 风格自动生成 200-300 字专业、无表情符号的推文，涵盖加密货币、地缘政治、科技/AI 和金融股市主题。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of @_FORAB Tweet Generator.
- Generates high-quality tweets (200-300 characters) in the style of @_FORAB.
- Supports four content categories: Crypto, Geopolitics, Tech/AI, and Finance/Stocks.
- Includes hooks, customizable elements, and interactive endings.
- Ensures professional tone without using emojis.
